data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): applier.py has NO module-level logger. Existing structured emissions use print(json.dumps({...}), file=sys.stderr) — see applier.py:468, 614. Pin the comment-fallback log to that pattern for consistency with sibling _handle_failed_write_result emissions. Test via capsys (capture stderr, json.loads the line, assert keys/values). Do NOT introduce import logging or logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) just for this branch.
